Oracle Database 19c에서 온라인 리두 로그가 ARCn을 거: A 10-step animated lesson that follows how, in Oracle Database 19c, online redo logs become archived logs through ARCn, collect in the fast recovery area (FRA), and are protected by RMAN backup sets and control file autobackups. It also covers the difference between RESTORE and RECOVER, and why the database stops when the FRA is full (ORA-19809, ORA-00257).
리두가 온라인 리두 로그 → 아카이브 로그 → RMAN 백업으로 옮겨 가: Follow in 10 steps how redo moves from online redo logs → archived logs → RMAN backups, and see how changes made after a backup can be recovered too.

새벽 1시 백업, 오후 3시 디스크 고장. 그 사이 데이터는?: Backup at 1 a.m., disk failure at 3 p.m. What about the data in between?
백업은 매일 새벽 1시에 받습니다. 오후 3시에 데이터 파일이 있는 디스: Backups run every day at 1 a.m. At 3 p.m. the disk holding the data files fails. Restoring the files from backup brings them back as they were at 1 a.m. Where do the thousands of orders that came in during the morning come from?
답은 리두 로그에 있습니다. 백업 뒤의 모든 변경이 리두로 남아 있으면: The answer is in the redo log. If every change since the backup is still kept as redo, those changes can be reapplied on top of the backup. The catch is that the online redo log reuses just a few files over and over. This lesson follows how that redo is collected so it is never lost.
복구할 수 있는 범위는 \"백업 + 그 뒤의 리두가 어디까지 남아 있나\: How far you can recover is decided by "the backup + how much redo after it still exists". With only a backup, you get back to the backup time; with all the redo, to just before the failure.
× 오후 3시 데이터 파일 디스크 고장: × data file disk fails at 3 p.m.
온라인 리두 로그는 세 개를 돌려 쓴다: The online redo log reuses three groups in turn
dbserver02의 ORCL에는 <span class=\"term\">: ORCL on dbserver02 has three online redo log groups. LGWR writes redo to the current group (CURRENT) and, when it fills, moves on to the next group. This is a log switch. After the third group comes the first again.
Administrator's Guide에 따르면 <code>NOARCHI: According to the Administrator's Guide, in NOARCHIVELOG mode a group that became inactive after a log switch is available for reuse by LGWR right away. Overwritten redo is gone, so, as the guide puts it, this mode protects against instance failure but not against media (disk) failure.
A NOARCHIVELOG database cannot recover transactions made after the backup. According to the guide, it can only be restored from whole backups taken while the database was closed.
ARCHIVELOG로 바꾸기: MOUNT에서 한 줄: Switching to ARCHIVELOG: one statement at MOUNT
로그 모드는 DB가 MOUNT 상태일 때만 바꿀 수 있습니다. 문서의 순: The log mode can only be changed while the database is mounted. The guide's order is SHUTDOWN IMMEDIATE → back up → STARTUP MOUNT → ALTER DATABASE ARCHIVELOG → ALTER DATABASE OPEN. This is where the MOUNT stage from ‘Instance and Database’ is used.
바꾼 뒤 <code>archive log list</code>를 보면 <: Afterwards, archive log list shows Archive Mode and Automatic archival Enabled. If a fast recovery area is configured and no other local archive destination is set, the guide says Oracle picks the FRA as the destination and shows it as USE_DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST.
문서는 로그 모드를 바꾼 뒤에는 데이터 파일과 컨트롤 파일을 모두 다시: The guide says to back up all data files and the control file again after changing the log mode, because backups taken in NOARCHIVELOG mode are no longer usable.
로그 스위치가 나면 ARCn이 복사본을 남긴다: After a log switch, ARCn keeps a copy
문서에 따르면 찬 그룹은 로그 스위치 직후 아카이브할 수 있게 되고, 자: According to the guide, a filled group becomes available for archiving right after a log switch, and with automatic archiving enabled the ARCn background process does the work. An archived redo log is a copy of one of the filled members of a redo log group.
이제 컨트롤 파일은 \"아카이브가 끝나기 전에는 그 그룹을 다시 쓰지 말: Now the control file marks that "this group must not be reused until it is archived". So only groups whose ARCHIVED column in v$log is YES get overwritten. The redo is no longer lost; it piles up in the FRA.
아카이브가 늦어지지 않도록 오라클은 필요하면 아카이버 프로세스를 여러 개: So that archiving does not fall behind, Oracle starts several archiver processes when needed. The n in ARCn is their number (ARC0, ARC1 …).
+ 그룹 2를 아카이브 로그로 복사: + group 2 copied to an archived log
빠른 복구 영역: 복구에 필요한 파일을 한곳에: Fast recovery area: recovery files in one place
<span class=\"term\">빠른 복구 영역</span>(FRA: The fast recovery area (FRA) is disk space managed by Oracle. According to the Backup and Recovery User's Guide it can hold RMAN disk backups, control file autobackups and archived logs, as well as flashback logs and copies of control files and online redo logs.
위치는 <code>DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST</code>,: The location is set by DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST and the limit by DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST_SIZE; the guide says to set the limit before the location. On dbserver02 it is on the /u01 disk with a 100G limit, and archivelog, backupset and autobackup directories are created inside it per date.
한도는 디스크 크기가 아니라 DB가 스스로 정한 할당량입니다. /u01에: The limit is a quota the database sets for itself, not the disk size. Even if /u01 has free space, the FRA counts as full once this limit is used up. The failure in scene 9 comes from this.
RMAN 백업: 데이터 파일과 아카이브 로그를 함께: RMAN backup: data files and archived logs together
<code>BACKUP DATABASE PLUS ARCHIVELOG</c: BACKUP DATABASE PLUS ARCHIVELOG backs up the data files and the archived logs together. The guide explains that archiving the logs right after the backup gives you a full set of archived logs through the time of the backup.
RMAN은 결과를 <span class=\"term\">백업 세트</sp: RMAN writes its output as logical units called backup sets, and each actual file inside one is a backup piece. Which backups exist and where is always recorded in the target database's control file. Without a separate recovery catalog database, the control file is the only place these records live.
RMAN에 처음 접속하면 <code>using target databas: The first RMAN command shows using target database control file instead of recovery catalog: backup records are kept in the control file, not in a catalog. So losing the control file also loses the backup records.
+ 컨트롤 파일에 백업 기록: + backup records in the control file
컨트롤 파일 자동 백업: 백업 기록의 백업: Control file autobackup: a backup of the backup records
<code>CONFIGURE CONTROLFILE AUTOBACKUP O: With CONFIGURE CONTROLFILE AUTOBACKUP ON, RMAN automatically backs up the control file and the server parameter file (SPFILE) after every backup and after structural changes to the database. According to the guide, in ARCHIVELOG mode an autobackup is also taken whenever the structure metadata in the control file changes.
컨트롤 파일을 모두 잃어도 이 자동 백업이 있으면 <code>RESTOR: Even if every control file is lost, this autobackup lets you bring one back with RESTORE CONTROLFILE FROM AUTOBACKUP. It contains the backup records from scene 6, so data file recovery can follow.
기본값은 19c 문서 안에서도 설명이 엇갈립니다. RMAN 환경 설정 장: Even the 19c documentation disagrees about the default. The RMAN configuration chapter says "ON by default when COMPATIBLE is 12.2 or higher", while the backup chapter says "OFF by default". So don't rely on memory; check with show all;.
~ 백업할 때마다 · 구조가 바뀔 때마다: ~ after each backup · after each structural change
사례: 데이터 파일이 사라졌다. RESTORE 다음 RECOVER: Case: a data file is gone. RESTORE, then RECOVER
오후 3시 디스크 장애로 USERS 테이블스페이스의 데이터 파일을 잃었습: The 3 p.m. disk failure took the data file of the USERS tablespace. First, RESTORE takes that file out of the backup set and puts it back in place. The file is as it was at backup time, so it cannot be used yet.
이어서 <span class=\"term\">RECOVER</span>가: Next, RECOVER applies the redo generated since. According to the guide, complete recovery restores the data files and then applies all redo generated after that backup, and RMAN automatically restores any needed archived logs from backup. Applying the online redo last brings the file to just before the failure.
1장면의 질문에 대한 답입니다. ARCHIVELOG + 백업 + 아카이브: This answers the question from scene 1. With ARCHIVELOG + a backup + all archived logs, even the morning's orders come back. In stage 5 of the DBA labs you delete a file and bring it back yourself.
~ RESTORE: 백업 세트 → USERS 데이터 파일: ~ RESTORE: backup set → USERS data file
사례: FRA가 가득 차면 DB가 멈춘다: Case: when the FRA is full, the database stops
배치가 몰린 주에 아카이브 로그가 평소보다 많이 쌓였습니다. FRA 한도: In a week of heavy batch jobs, far more archived logs piled up than usual. Once the FRA limit is used up, ARCn can no longer make copies. A group that is not archived cannot be overwritten, so LGWR soon has nowhere to write.
Administrator's Guide는 아카이브하다가 디스크가 차면 치: The Administrator's Guide warns that if the disk fills while archiving, a fatal error occurs and the database stops responding. The alert log shows ORA-19809 (limit exceeded for recovery files), and new connections get ORA-00257.
급하면 <code>db_recovery_file_dest_size</co: In a hurry, raise db_recovery_file_dest_size, then use RMAN DELETE OBSOLETE to remove files the retention policy no longer needs. Deleting with Linux rm leaves the RMAN records out of step. The DBA labs stage 5 lesson "FRA full" is this scene.
× ARCn 복사 실패 → 그룹을 덮어쓸 수 없음: × ARCn copy fails → group cannot be overwritten
정리: 리두를 모으고, 백업하고, 정해진 만큼만 남긴다: Recap: collect the redo, back it up, keep only what the policy says
ARCHIVELOG에서 리두는 온라인 리두 로그(LGWR) → 아카이브: In ARCHIVELOG mode, redo moves from the online redo log (LGWR) → archived logs (ARCn) → backup sets (RMAN). Every record is kept in the control file, which in turn is protected by autobackup.
아카이브 로그가 모두 있으면 \"장애 직전\"뿐 아니라 \"실수 직전 시: With all archived logs you can go back not only to "just before the failure" but also to "just before a mistake". Point-in-time recovery in stage 6 of the DBA labs does exactly that.
~ 온라인 리두 → 아카이브 로그 → 백업 세트: ~ online redo → archived logs → backup sets
얼마나 남길지는 <span class=\"term\">보관 정책</spa: The retention policy decides how much to keep. According to the guide the default is REDUNDANCY 1, and older backups beyond the policy become OBSOLETE. Oracle deletes obsolete files in the FRA automatically when space is needed, and you can also delete them any time with DELETE OBSOLETE.
